## Guidelines and reference documents

Official links updated for the course. For the European Union, EUR-Lex is used whenever possible instead of old Commission PDF locations.

::: {.guide-grid}
::: {.guide-card}
### Market definition

::: {.guide-doc}
[EU]{.pill .eu} [2024]{.pill .current} [Market Definition Notice](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/C/2024/1645/oj/eng)

[Commission Notice C/2024/1645; replaces the 1997 notice.]{.guide-note}
:::

::: {.guide-doc}
[UK]{.pill .uk} [legacy]{.pill .legacy} [Market definition — OFT403](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/market-definition)

[Adopted by the CMA, but the 2004 text remains unamended.]{.guide-note}
:::

:::

::: {.guide-card}
### Market power and dominance

::: {.guide-doc}
[EU]{.pill .eu} [current]{.pill .current} [Article 102 enforcement priorities](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/ES/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A52009XC0224%2801%29)

[2009 Guidance, read together with the 2023 amendments.]{.guide-note}
:::

::: {.guide-doc}
[EU]{.pill .eu} [2023]{.pill .current} [Amendments to the Article 102 Guidance](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/ES/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A52023XC0331%2801%29)

[Updated enforcement priorities.]{.guide-note}
:::

::: {.guide-doc}
[UK]{.pill .uk} [legacy]{.pill .legacy} [Assessment of market power — OFT415](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/assessment-of-market-power)

[Adopted by the CMA; original 2004 text.]{.guide-note}
:::

::: {.guide-doc}
[UK]{.pill .uk} [legacy]{.pill .legacy} [Abuse of a dominant position — OFT402](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/abuse-of-a-dominant-position)

[Adopted by the CMA; original 2004 text.]{.guide-note}
:::

:::

**Status note.** I do not force a U.S. document into every topic when there is no general current guideline. Historical documents remain useful, but are labelled as legacy rather than presented as current guidance.
